name: Types of Headaches meme
meaning: A medical-style chart of headaches showing where each one hurts, ending with a head that is entirely red. For naming the most painful, all-consuming source of stress.
when_to_use: top = the name of the worst headache (above the fully red head, bottom right). bottom = optional small extra line. The worst one is the punchline.
baked_in_text: The image already has the title "Types of Headaches" and the labels "Migraine", "Hypertension" and "Stress". Only name the fourth.
